self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Solemn Silence: causing an Elemental Reaction grants +32% Max HP for 12s, plus an additional +32% (64% total) during Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam. Modeled with the Moonsign bonus included. Works even off-field.

en.flavor: A longsword forged from metal that makes a mournful sound when swung.

refinements.1: Upon causing an Elemental Reaction, increases Max HP by <r>16%</r> for 12s. Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Max HP from this effect is further increased by <r>16%</r>. This effect can be triggered even if the equipping character is off-field.

refinements.4: Upon causing an Elemental Reaction, increases Max HP by <r>28%</r> for 12s. Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Max HP from this effect is further increased by <r>28%</r>. This effect can be triggered even if the equipping character is off-field.

fr.flavor: Une longue épée forgée à partir de métal qui produit un son lugubre lorsqu'elle est brandie.

refinements.1: Déclencher une réaction élémentaire augmente les PV max de <r>16 %</r> pendant 12 s. Signelune « Lueur ascendante » : les PV max de cet effet augmentent de <r>16 %</r> supplémentaires.
